left.alt: Three items entering 55 milliseconds apart, each rising over 620 milliseconds

items.value: Content enters once with a 16px rise. It does not re-animate when scrolling back up.
Every loop starts paused and plays only while its section and tab are visible.
Multi-step choreography runs on one timeline so steps cannot drift out of sync.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, nothing is animated. The markup is the final frame.
The browser scrolls. No library adds smooth scrolling, scroll hijacking, or inertia.
